_comment: Generated by tools/extract/extract_door_poses.py (docs/progress/door-poses.md): the END POSE of every node Arena's gates move, next to the node's closed pose in the scene. barrier = the path of the gate's root (an opened_barriers entry; Equator's booth doors are not barriers: the assembly root under SPAWN_DOORS or Respawn_2), part = the barrier root's direct child (what BoothDoorRepairs switches off; "" = the root itself moves), node = the transform path below the part that is animated ("" = the part itself), positions and euler angles are LOCAL to the node's parent (Unity localPosition / localEulerAngles). source = clip (a Mecanim clip: Bowl), dotanimator (Arena's DOTween script: Equator, Bay5) or borrowed (Arena authors no motion for this gate; a neighbour's is used). seconds = Arena's own duration, unscaled. ease = smoothstep (the client's stand-in for Bowl's clips), linear, inOutQuint or curve (curve = Hermite keys [time, value, inSlope, outSlope] on a 0..1 timeline). at = null, or the WORLD position of the barrier root instance (tells repeated hierarchy paths apart, matched within 0.05 m). Euler angles of clip poses are the clip's own raw values (interpolate component-wise); rotations of dotanimator poses are interpolated as a quaternion slerp between the two triples. ArenaMapRegistry.<Map>.DoorPoses mirrors this file number for number (validate_map_descriptors.py and the DoorPoseSidecarTests). Object names and derived numbers only (the curve keys are derived numbers too); no Arena asset or file is stored. ease outBack = DOTween's Ease.OutBack with its default overshoot constant 1.70158 (Arena's DotAnimator ease number 27): the path fraction is (k-1)^2 * ((s+1)(k-1) + s) + 1 for the elapsed fraction k, reaches 1 at k = 1 and passes it (about 1.1) on the way, so the node overshoots its open pose by about a tenth of the travel before it settles on it.
